text: Your online game isn't slow. It's waiting.
Top: the client sends your input, and waits for the server. Every move shows up a hundred and fifty milliseconds late.
Bottom: client-side prediction. You move instantly, and the server, in gold, catches up behind you.
When the server agrees, nothing changes. When it doesn't, you correct. Smoothly.
So, would you trust the client with movement? Tell me below.
